questions.q: Which node must NOT be on the "autopilot status → setpoints" path?
questions.explain: A non-critical node must not block control.

questions.q: A lifecycle node in the inactive state:
options: Is waiting for a service response
questions.explain: activate takes it to active. In inactive, lifecycle publishers are silent, but timers and subscriptions keep running unless you stop them yourself.

questions.q: Watchdog: losing the targets from the camera gives the level
questions.explain: A non-critical input means a degraded function.

questions.q: Why is there hysteresis on input recovery?
options: So the input does not flap the mode
To bring the tracking function back faster

questions.q: Who is the last line of defense if the whole application crashes?
options: The watchdog node on the companion
questions.explain: Safety lives at the lowest level.

questions.q: Neural network inference delays the setpoint timer. The fix:
options: A faster timer for the setpoint stream
questions.explain: Separate callback groups and a MultiThreadedExecutor, or a separate process: heavy callbacks must not block control.

questions.q: Where do you keep a secret VPN key?
options: In the node's YAML parameter file
questions.explain: Parameters are visible to every participant.

questions.q: Circular bag recording on board is set with:
questions.explain: The ring deletes old files so the disk does not fill up; the flag exists since rosbag2 for Lyrical and works only together with -d/--max-bag-duration or -b/--max-bag-size (on their own those only split the bag into files).
